Your brain cannot tell that the people on Instagram are strangers. 📱

Mark Manson calls social media a shame machine that runs 24/7 — because when a human face talks to us, our primal wiring assumes they're part of our group. So the social radar that's meant to catch real-life mistakes is on overdrive, every day, for everyone.

That's the machine you're scrolling right now.
